lastCompletedStory.title: Defensive hardening of in-repo js-yaml default import + runbook note

nextStoryContext: US-003 switched src/commands/status.ts from `import yaml from 'js-yaml'` (default import) to `import { load as yamlLoad } from 'js-yaml'` (named import, forward-compatible across js-yaml v4 and v5). Verified grep: zero remaining default js-yaml imports in src/. Also appended section (g) to docs/recovery-runbook.md explaining the CAM-69 stale-binary 'Missing default export' failure and the rebuild/reinstall recovery path. All non-operator stories in this PRD now pass: true.

officialDocsValidated.summary: v4.1.1 confirmed: `load` is a named export (function), no default export. Named import `import { load } from 'js-yaml'` is forward-compatible with v5. Verified via local node_modules introspection (npm 403 blocked WebFetch; GitHub page showed v5 uses named `load` as well).
